uutiset.t: Zverev books place in ATP Finals semi-finals
uutiset.s: Alexander Zverev booked his spot in the knockout stages of the ATP Finals after sealing a ruthless 6-2 7-6 (7-4) victory over Ben Shelton in Turin on Tuesday night, in a rematch of this year's US Open final.

uutiset.t: Mercedes set to run ADUO engine upgrade in Las Vegas with one driver
uutiset.s: World champions Mercedes will bring their ADUO turbocharger upgrade to this weekend's Las Vegas Grand Prix, although George Russell will not use it to avoid having to take another grid penalty in his bid for second place in the Drivers' Championship.
